canon: Continuation of The Last Departure; existing Anki, Brutus, Ancient AI, Relay, Naki and Annu only.

chapters.title: Broken Canopy
briefing: Relay
The extraction corridor is closed. Reach the floodgate transmitter and we can trace a safe approach.
Brutus
Four expedition motorcycles survived in the sealed cargo cradle. Take one. Keep your speed up: Annu have the service road covered.
Anki
The charge comes with us. We are not leaving a weapon in their forest.

stages.title: Leave the wreck behind
dialogue: Brutus
Throttle forward, steer early. Four times walking speed means less time to correct.

stages.title: The fallen giants
dialogue: Brutus
Read the open lane beyond the next trunk. Keep the motorcycle upright.

stages.title: Broken river spans
dialogue: Brutus
Build speed before the ramp. Level the motorcycle before you land.

stages.title: Annu observation line
dialogue: Brutus
They are tracking slow targets. A clean landing is better protection than stopping here.

stages.title: The old haul road
dialogue: Brutus
Brake before the bend, accelerate as it opens.

stages.title: Floodgate approach
dialogue: Brutus
The pumping station is ahead. Leave the bikes in cover; we continue on foot.

ending: Anki
Why does the road lead into a reservoir?
Brutus
It did not when our maps were drawn. The floodgate can lower the freight channel.

chapters.title: The Floodgate
briefing: Brutus
The drowned freight causeway is our route inland. Restore the intake, open the bypass, and drain the lower basin.
Anki
That water feeds their settlements. Lower the channel, not the reservoir.

stages.title: Restore intake pressure
dialogue: Brutus
Open the valve slowly; the old bearings are still carrying pressure.

stages.title: Open the bypass
dialogue: Brutus
Keep the bypass open while pressure equalizes. The upper reservoir must stay full.

stages.title: Lower the freight basin
dialogue: Brutus
The lower channel is draining. We have a route without cutting off their water.

stages.title: Recover the ancient route
dialogue: Brutus
This route terminates at Sanctuary. The gold network is still responding.

ending: Ancient AI
Hydraulic balance preserved. Returning survey party acknowledged.
Anki
It noticed what we chose to protect.
Brutus
Then we should keep giving it reasons to listen.
evidence: Brutus
These modern repair plates fit machinery older than Connectuct. The Annu have kept this water system running for generations.
Ancient AI
Upper basin: residential supply. Lower basin: freight overflow. Do not conflate custodial functions.

chapters.title: Sanctuary of Records
briefing: Anki
Our oldest drawings showed this place empty.
Brutus
The Annu rebuilt around the old machines. Align the archive circuits; we need to know what the reserves sustain.

stages.title: The arrival record
dialogue: Brutus
This circuit records our ancestors leaving. We were not the last people to live here.

stages.title: The living grid
dialogue: Brutus
These conductors regulate water and hospitals. Extracting them would endanger the people here.

stages.title: The abandoned reserve
dialogue: Brutus
There is another stockpile: retired conductors. Protect the archive while I recover its inventory.

stages.title: A different objective
dialogue: Brutus
The foundry can reclaim abandoned stock without stripping their active grid.

ending: Anki
We came for enough gold to save Connectuct. Not permission to take someone else's home.
Ancient AI
Custodial restriction retained. Reclamation route available.
evidence: Anki
Our departure is carved here. Someone kept our history even after we forgot theirs.
Ancient AI
Retired conductors: awaiting reclamation. Active conductors: protected. Resource allocation must preserve the living.

chapters.title: The Hollow Foundry
briefing: Brutus
Cooling, sorting, refinement, freight: restore this foundry in that order.
Anki
Only retired stock. Leave every live conductor connected.

stages.title: Cold before current
dialogue: Brutus
Cooling first. The furnaces reject a restart while the return loop is dry.

stages.title: Sort the broken network
dialogue: Brutus
The separator is freeing gold components from retired equipment. Hold this floor.

stages.title: The first usable gold
dialogue: Brutus
Refined conductors are coming off the line. Gold is the control material, not the fuel.

stages.title: Freight for Connectuct
dialogue: Brutus
Crates sealed. The rail yard can move the load to the orbital relay.

ending: Anki
A district could keep its lights on with this.
Brutus
If we can get it home. The freight signals just went dark.
evidence: Brutus
Gold regulates these control assemblies. The thermal plant supplies their energy. The archive makes the distinction explicit.
Anki
Every crate is marked retired equipment. We can account for every piece we take.

chapters.title: Blackout Rail
briefing: Brutus
Annu defenders isolated the freight yard. Restore its signals and switch heaters before moving the recovered stock.
Anki
We need the line, not their city.

stages.title: Restore the yard signal
dialogue: Brutus
Signal power is back. Follow the lit service lane.

stages.title: Free the frozen switch
dialogue: Brutus
The turnout is seized. Hold the heater current until the rails release.

stages.title: Reserve the freight line
dialogue: Brutus
Cargo route secured. The passenger branch remains isolated from us.

stages.title: The orbital feed
stages.action: Restore power to the sky relay
dialogue: Brutus
Its approach registry still thinks the last expedition never left.

ending: Ancient AI
Arrival record incomplete. Airspace remains quarantined.
Brutus
The same response we heard before the crash. The registry may be the fault.
evidence: Anki
The passenger schedules are recent. This is their working railway.
Brutus
The orbital feed and the freight interlock share a much older control network. Reconnecting one woke the other.

chapters.title: The Sky Mirror
briefing: Brutus
The orbital mirror carries the ancient approach registry. Align the dishes and compare its orders with our flight recorder.
Anki
Find out what happened before another ship comes through.

stages.title: Align azimuth
dialogue: Brutus
The old beacon is transmitting a flight-control handoff that predates our ship.

stages.title: Align elevation
dialogue: Brutus
The flight recorder matches an incompatible quarantine handoff. An obsolete system triggered the fault, not an Annu weapon.

stages.title: Rebuild the corridor
dialogue: Brutus
Hold the antenna while I transmit a compatible flight profile. No one repeats our landing.

stages.title: Open the sky
dialogue: Brutus
We have a safe corridor. The reclamation engine still will not release the reserve.

ending: Relay
Approach record received. A safe return window is opening.
Ancient AI
Reserve transfer denied. Quarantine interlock remains engaged.
Anki
Then we go to the lock itself.
evidence: Brutus
The recorder contains a control handoff, then incompatible attitude commands. We have evidence now; the signal alone was never proof.
Ancient AI
Departure register incomplete. Quarantine duration exceeds original maintenance interval. Custodial review overdue.

chapters.title: The Last Reserve
briefing: Brutus
The reserve gallery was sealed centuries ago. Our recovered excavation charge can open its obsolete access wall.
Anki
Verify the gallery is empty. The charge opens stone, not the living grid.

stages.title: Open the sealed gallery
dialogue: Brutus
The gallery is clear. Set the charge in the old survey recess and stand behind stone cover.

stages.title: Verify the reserve
dialogue: Brutus
This stock was removed from service before the Annu rebuilt the surface.

stages.title: Isolate the transport cradle
dialogue: Brutus
The engine mistakes an obsolete transport lock for a life-support circuit.

stages.title: Protect the transfer
dialogue: Brutus
Keep the controls powered. The reclamation engine is waking; protect the reserve.

ending: Ancient AI
Conflicting custodial orders. Reclamation defense engaged.
Anki
We are here to finish the repair.
Brutus
Three mechanical interlocks. Break their actuators, then restore the original custodial priorities.
evidence: Anki
The charge survived the wreck, the forest and the road. Now we can finally use it for the excavation it was built for.
Brutus
Both instructions are valid separately: preserve the reserve, and reclaim unused stock. The obsolete transport lock prevents the machine distinguishing them.

chapters.title: Ancient Nest
briefing: Brutus
The reclamation engine is enforcing incompatible orders. Arm each maintenance bypass, then destroy its exposed actuator.
Anki
Keep the reserve intact. We stop the machinery, not the intelligence inside it.
Ancient AI
Custodial conflict unresolved. Stand clear of reclamation sweep.

stages.title: Break the first interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Fire at the amber actuator. When the floor turns amber, move into a dark lane.

stages.title: Break the second interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Use the stone baffles between sweeps. The next lock is carrying the load.

stages.title: Break the final interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Break the last mechanical lock, then reach the custodial console.

stages.title: Bring the gold home
stages.action: Restore custodial priorities and authorize departure
dialogue: Anki
Protect the living. Reclaim what was abandoned. Let us keep another world alive.

ending: Ancient AI
Conflict resolved. Living infrastructure preserved. Reclaimed reserve released.
Relay
Extraction ship docked. Cargo verified. Return corridor clear. Connectuct is waiting.
Anki
Home is also what we choose to protect.
Brutus
Gold for the repairs. The engineering archive for what comes after. Departure authorized.
The expedition returns with reclaimed gold and a shared history. The first restoration district comes back into light.
evidence: Ancient AI
Original custodial priority: sustain the living. Secondary priority: preserve knowledge. Reserve retention: subordinate.
Anki
There is enough here for the repairs, if we bring back the knowledge to keep repairing.
